svg.title: ARMOR-COMMON architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-COMMON holds the JSON Schemas of the node messages, a Python validator that interprets them, the conformance vectors that every implementation runs, the generated TypeScript and Kotlin types, the OpenAPI file of the server and the firmware base shared by the five nodes. ARMOR-SERVER runs the vectors and implements the routes, ARMOR-STUDIO keeps a copy of the generated types, the nodes receive the firmware base, and the Android app does not consume the Kotlin types yet.
